stem: At a routine review, which advice should be included as a general principle for ketosis prevention on future sick days?

options.text: Avoid all fluids once ketones appear
Wait until the next morning to respond to rising readings
Ignore symptoms if the child still looks well

explanation: Maintain hydration is a key principle of ketosis prevention during sick days. It helps reduce dehydration and supports ongoing sick-day management alongside monitoring and insulin continuity.

citations.source: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf
citations.title: Diabetes Sick Day Management

optionExplanations.A: Correct because maintaining hydration is a core sick-day measure that helps prevent ketosis and dehydration.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because fluids should not be withheld when ketones are present; hydration is part of prevention and management.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because sick-day responses should be prompt rather than delayed until the next morning.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because exercise is not a reliable strategy for clearing ketones in sick-day management.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because symptoms and ketone risk should be actively monitored even if the child appears settled.

sourceRefs: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf
